Allow rule for <TS_IP_A> replaced by DROP (raw PREROUTING): a NEW Mac connection fails (rc=1, DROP counter 108 pkts / 14245 B, read 6 s into the later 82 s block of 6b), existing A<->R connection lost, message stays 'sent' (attempts 1-5) with no receipt, restore -> A Connected 3.5 s later, queued message delivered 33.4 s after restore. This is the same single run as check 6.

FINDING: rules in DOCKER-USER (the usual place for a docker-published port) do NOT restrict tailnet traffic on this box: tailscaled's ts-forward chain sits before DOCKER-USER in FORWARD and ACCEPTs everything forwarded from tailscale0. With a DROP for the Mac's IP in DOCKER-USER the Mac still connected, DOCKER-USER counters stayed 0 while ts-forward counted packets. The working restriction is in the raw table (PREROUTING), which runs before nat and before ts-forward.

So the libp2p traffic is inside the WireGuard tunnel.

SINGLE TRIAL. DROP of <TS_IP_A> -> tcp/60000 for 120 s (block 19:35:57.96, restore 19:37:59.12). Message queued at +10.8 s: state 'sent' attempts 1-5, no receipt. R began retransmitting at 19:36:07.9 and its socket to A vanished at 19:36:45.9 (47.9 s after block, ~38 s after the first retransmission; tcp_retries2=6 on R). Node A first reported CanConnect at 19:36:45.4 (+47.4 s), CannotConnect from 19:36:55. After restore A listed R Connected 3.5 s later (19:38:02.6); the queued message was delivered 33.4 s after restore (143.8 s after it was queued, attempts 6). Right after restore R briefly held several extra connections from the Mac (see the sampler), pruned by 19:38:20.

UNPLANNED second block (slow instabox exec round trips made a ~15 s block last 82 s: 19:39:16.7 to 19:40:38.5). A killed its connections at 19:40:02 but its FIN/RST were dropped, so R kept an idle ESTABLISHED socket with no unacked data (tcp_retries2 never ran) and closed every new connection from the Mac (R sent FIN first; tcpdump). A listed R CannotConnect for 7 min 25 s after the path was restored, until R's stale socket disappeared at 19:48:02 (exactly 8:00 after A closed; cause UNTESTED); A Connected 2 s later (19:48:04). Matches docs/relay-setup.md section 8a / E12; tcp_retries2=6 does NOT help when R has nothing to send.
